title: Optimize hybrid RRF score map preallocation
constraints: Preserve hybrid search RRF scoring and ordering semantics
rationale: Hybrid search merges BM25 and vector candidates into an RRF score HashMap. The candidate counts are already known, so preallocating the map reduces rehash and allocation churn during score accumulation.
steps: Compute score map capacity from text and vector candidate counts
Verify hybrid result ordering and zero-limit behavior
expected_impact: Reduces allocation churn during hybrid search candidate fusion without changing scoring semantics.
